title: Describe has_password in the API schema
bug: Every user object now exposes the password hash.

review.why: The PR adds a `password_hash` field to the schema with `dump_only=True`, which only exposes the existing database column in API responses and documentation without changing validation, behavior, or security.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR adds password_hash to the schema with dump_only=True, exposing actual password hashes in GET /api/feed and GET /api/posts responses, which is a security regression not mentioned in the description.
